The '''All Terrain Armored Heavy Transport (AT-AHT)''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] in service with [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]] that opposed it.

==Characteristics==
The walker was an improvement on the older [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], with better armor for the head and main chassis as well as guns mounted on the passenger-section, above and to each side of the cockpit.<ref name="LECG" />

==Usage==
It was primarily used on worlds where conditions prevented the use of repulsorlift vehicles, including the Imperial capital of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. It was used to break through enemy defenses and scatter enemy troops.<ref name="LECG" />
